Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software all have to work at micron-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem.

That’s what we do.

At Formlabs, we’re building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they’re building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA.

The Print Optimization Team takes on the challenge of optimizing the intersection of hardware, software, and materials to deliver industry leading print performance. We strive to make our SLA & SLS product line print parts as quickly, reliably, easily, accurately, and beautifully as possible. We are a collaborative team, with a diverse background, passionate about pushing the boundaries of print performance across our product lines.

As a 3D Print Optimization Engineer you will be continuously using your problem solving skills to drive improved performance.

We are customer focused, and the first step of tackling the problem is understanding what the performance boost we are trying to achieve, and how many customers will benefit. Will customers be able to print parts faster? More reliability? Will they be easier to post-process, or print more accurately?

If you’re excited about process optimization, solving multi-disciplinary challenges, and bringing to market the best print performance possible, we want you as a 3D Print Optimization Engineer!

The Job:

- Push the capabilities of our SLA & SLS 3D printing platforms

- Drive root cause analysis, considering mechanics, fluid dynamics, software, chemistry, optics, electronics, thermodynamics, and customer behavior

- Design efficient experiments that tease out underlying behavior in a complicated system of variables

- Tackle multi-disciplinary problems

- Develop and commercialize solutions that make a real and immediate impact on customer print performance

You:

- Are focused on the customer

- Have a strong sense of ownership with great attention to detail

- Are hands-on and willing to cross discipline boundaries to solve a problem

- Work autonomously and learn new skills to tackle objective

Overview

Minerals Technologies Inc. (MTI)

MTI is a leading, technology-driven specialty minerals company that develops, produces, and markets a broad range of mineral and mineral-based products, related systems and services. MTI serves a wide range of consumer and industrial markets, including household and personal care, paper, foundry, steel, construction and environmental solutions around the world.

Why Intern at MTI?

- Develop professional skills through structured learning and development experiences.

- Learn from experienced professionals through mentorship and coaching.

- Participate in our Speaker Series events featuring business and technical leaders.

- Connect with employees and fellow interns through networking events and Coffee Chats.

- Explore career opportunities across a global manufacturing and technology organization.

- Present your work and accomplishments to business leaders at the end of your internship.

- Build a professional network and gain valuable experience that prepares you for future internships and full-time career opportunities.

At
MTI, interns are valued contributors who work alongside experienced professionals to solve real business challenges and make meaningful contributions from day one.

Responsibilities

Job Summary:

The GIS Intern will be responsible for supporting various mapping and geospatial projects from early-stage development through operations. Under limited supervision, the GIS Intern will support environmental, land tenure, mining and geology data maintenance and design.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

- Data entry and design

- Digitizing spatial mining assets and infrastructure, and analysis.

- Compile mining and reclamation geospatial data for various reports and operational initiatives.

- Support implementation of mobile mapping and deployment of mapping technologies.

OE/Lean: 5S, Kaizen, Daily Management Control, Standard Work

Qualifications

Qualifications/Requirements:

The requirements listed in the sections that follow are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required to perform the duties of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions (primary duties) of the job.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

- Basic understanding of Geographic Information Systems (GIS), cartography, geospatial analysis, and spatial data management.

- Familiarity with GIS software such as Esri ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, QGIS, or similar mapping platforms.

- Knowledge of geographic data concepts, including coordinate systems, projections, geodatabases, and GPS data collection.

- Ability to collect, organize, analyze, and interpret spatial and non-spatial data from multiple sources.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

- Ability to create maps, dashboards, visualizations, and reports that clearly communicate geographic information.

- Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Ability to manage multiple assignments, prioritize tasks, and meet established deadlines.

- Willingness to learn new technologies, software applications, and geospatial methodologies.

- Ability to maintain accurate records and handle confidential or sensitive information appropriately.

Education:

- Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master’s degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Geography, Geospatial Science, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Urban Planning, Computer Science, Surveying, or a related field.

- Coursework in GIS, cartography, remote sensing, geospatial analysis, data management, computer mapping, or related disciplines is preferred.

Working Conditions:

While performing the duties of this position, the employee may work in a combination of office, laboratory, manufacturing, or other operational environments depending on assigned projects and business needs.

Responsibilities may include sitting, standing, walking, bending, and using standard office equipment including computers, telephones, printers, and copiers. The position may also require interaction with manufacturing equipment, laboratory instruments, production processes, or outdoor work areas under the supervision of Company personnel.

The employee will regularly communicate with internal and external stakeholders through face-to-face interactions, telephone calls, electronic communications, and written correspondence.

Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, hearing protection, hard hats, steel-toed footwear, high-visibility clothing, and other site-specific PPE, may be required when entering manufacturing, laboratory, or field locations. Adherence to all MTI safety policies, procedures, and training requirements is mandatory.

Work Hours:

Work schedule will be established based on business needs and the intern's academic schedule and availability.

Safety Training:

New employees hired into this position will receive New Employee Safety Training through the Company's learning management system.

About Base

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.

About the Role

Base's Finance & Business Operations team combines financial planning & analysis with business decision-making & strategy across our vertically integrated business, directly supporting Base's leadership team. We map our work to the core functions of the business, like go to market, deployments, engineering, and manufacturing, and we embed in both the daily operations and long-term planning of these functions. Team members are expected to be sharp analysts who can make the best decisions for the company and implement them, and high-EQ partners to our teammates as we make tough business and financial decisions. Base does not have a centralized strategy, strategic finance, analytics, corporate development, or related functions; this team is our equivalent of each of these things at similar companies.

As our MBA intern, you'll get a real piece of that work for the summer, not a side project. You'll take a defined slice of whatever the team is running right now and drive it to a decision.

What You'll Do

- Build the model, own a forecast and plan vs. actuals, define and drive operating metrics, and work with teammates across the business to achieve our highest-priority goals.

- Provide strategic insights and conclusions based on your analysis, and defend your assumptions to the people who have to hit them.

- Support planning and resource management for a specific operating function (e.g., headcount, make-buy decisions, investment approvals).

- Identify initiatives that improve Base's financial performance and outlook.

- Own a discrete project end to end, such as a workstream in an acquisition integration, a business plan for a new market or product entry, a cross-functional analytical program roll-out, or the scoreboard a team is missing, and leave behind something that still runs without you.

- Run work across functions without authority; rally owners in engineering, market operations, manufacturing, accounting, and customer operations around high-impact initiatives.

- Know the business and our team well: spend time on the factory floor, ride along on an install, and sit with the field, market operations, sales, and marketing teams.

What You'll Bring

- Currently pursuing an MBA and returning for your second year in the fall.

- Experience modeling complex businesses and decisions, and communicating the outputs clearly.

- Familiarity with Excel and SQL, or a strong willingness to learn fast.

- Comfort operating without a map, leading cross-functional work without authority, and creating structure where none exists.

- Fluency working alongside AI: you know how to get great outputs, when to check its work, and when to drive the analysis yourself.

About the Team

The Base business operations team is responsible for some of the company's highest-leverage outcomes: financing our growth, commercial partnerships, acquisitions and integrations, new market and product entries, and the programs that span too many teams to have a natural owner. It is a set of small teams of generalists who work directly with Base's founders, pick up the problem that matters most, build the structure and analysis it needs, and hand back something that runs itself.

Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.

Our Values

- First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

- Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

- Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

- Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

- Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

- Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

- Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.

Do the best work of your life at Base.
